scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.format:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
